name: Join us for 3daysofdesign
description:
During 3daysofdesign we will present our refurbished showroom and a blue-themed mini shop throughout all three days. Come take a seat in our new wooden chair design, Timb, that we are showcasing for the first time, and enjoy a cup of coffee brewed by local coffee-aficionados, @prologcoffeebar.

name: 3daysofdesign 2020
description: Experience the newest concepts within lifestyle, furniture and interiors. Meet the players crafting the future of sustainable design. Experience Copenhagen’s creative energy. It all takes place at a variety of events, exhibitions and more during 3daysofdesign, and you’re invited.

name: Sindroms x 3daysofdesign: Evergreen Launch & Opening
description:
We would like to invite you to the 3daysofdesign HUB, inside Copenhagen's Designmuseum, which Sindroms will transform into an urban oasis meant to reset your senses and inspire an evergreen mindset.

Join us to experience the oasis and to celebrate the release of Sindroms’ 5th issue, the Evergreen Sindrom, as well as the opening of this years’ 3daysofdesign.

As a treat for event guests only, Sindroms has collaborated with culinary artist Augusta Sørensen to deliver a sweet, enticing culinary experience in the form of a limited-edition mystery box. If you’d like to get a box at the event, you can pre-order one of the 20 Omakase: Amuse-Bouche boxes here: https://www.sindroms.com/shop/omakasegreen

The new issue of Sindroms will be available during the event, or you can pre-order it on our website, and pick up your copies in person at the event. Just choose ‘Copenhagen Launch Pick-up’ as the shipping method: https://www.sindroms.com/shop/evergreen

As part of the evergreen oasis, our friends at Spectra & Space will present Evergreen: Captured, an organic digital interpretation of nature's fascinating forms. A sample of Nordic flora is captured and illuminated for exploration. The contrast between man-made and true sense of nature is amplified. In architecture, we often design the world with absolute straight lines – while in nature, no absolutes exist. The installation is supported by Slabslanten. 


IMPORTANT: Precautions will be taken to ensure the safety of all of our guests. We kindly ask you to sign-up for one of the three available time slots, which each have a maximum capacity of 100 people. This way, we can make sure we follow the event regulations at all times and minimize risks. 

If you are not able to come celebrate with us during the event, you can still stop by to experience the oasis on September 4th (10.00 - 18.00), and on September 5th (10.00 - 14.00). The Evergreen: Captured installation is located in the courtyard, and can therefore be visited until 21.00 during all 3 days.

About Sindroms
Sindroms first launched in 2017, when it started establishing itself as a platform delivering monochrome states of mind by crafting worlds in which colour takes a predominant and unexpected role. Sindroms delivers monochrome experiences through creative services and products and through print, in the shape of Sindroms magazine.

Previous Sindroms magazine issues have explored the colours red, yellow, white, and pink, while the 5th edition explores evergreen. With a particular interest in evergreen mindsets, practices and design, our fifth issue serves as a breath of fresh air and inspires conversations for achieving a better normal. In this edition, we explored life in all its forms, with a particular interest in the evergreen. What does prosperity mean now? How do we manage to continue growing? What is evergreen design? Why is the human-nature relationship so vital? The latest issue explores this all within 160 pages of conceptual, carefully-curated editorials, thought pieces and striking visual essays.

About 3daysofdesign
3daysofdesign is Denmark’s annual design event. A showcase for you to discover and experience new ideas within the realm of lifestyle, design, furniture, lighting and interior design. The event features a curated selection of noteworthy brands from Denmark and abroad as part of our programme of events taking place all around Copenhagen. It’s an exclusive event that’s open to the general public, attracting the press, editors, bloggers, buyers, designers, architects and design enthusiasts worldwide. Everyone is invited to visit the showrooms, galleries, exhibitions and design talks, to see previews of new products and new trends forecasted for the future. Denmark has a proud reputation as a design nation and Copenhagen is its capital of cool.

About Spectra & Space
Spectra & Space is a lighting design studio specialising in light experiences in spatial context.
